workload.note: Team-provided baseline (114 car/73 rec/1023 total yds/8 TD) matches Wikipedia's rush(537)+rec(486)=1023 yds and 8 TD split; exact game/target counts not independently verified. Named Steelers team MVP by teammates.

contract.note: 2-year, $14M deal ($9.83M guaranteed) with TB. Buccaneers.com says signed 2026-03-12; Wikipedia says 2026-03-13 - minor date conflict, later (Wikipedia) not clearly more authoritative, both cited.

scheme.note: New Bucs OC (ex-Atlanta OC/QB coach lineage). Footballguys (2026-03-10) notes his Atlanta scheme featured a 23% RB target share, 4th-highest in NFL, cited as reason Gainwell should be 'schemed into the game plan.'

competition.name: Bucky Irving
competition.note: Full-go, unlimited at start of camp per buccaneers.com (2026-07-29); recovered from 2025 shoulder surgery that cost him 7 games. Ourlads TB depth chart lists him RB1.

notes: Ourlads depth chart (fetched 2026-08-11) lists order: Bucky Irving (RB1), Kenny Gainwell (RB2), Sean Tucker (RB3), Josh Williams (RB4), Kadarius Calloway (RB5).

SI/Onsi Bucs RB-room preview (2026-07-10): expects 'a bigger shift to more of a balanced attack,' projecting Irving and Gainwell both to top 500 rush yards plus similar receiving yardage, with neither reaching 1,000 total.
Footballguys (2026-03-10): projects Irving to handle lead rushing/goal-line work while Gainwell fills a receiving-down role with PPR emphasis; no specific carry/target split numbers given.
Mike Evans left TB for SF in free agency, opening target volume in the passing game generally.

camp.quote: He feels fine, he's great. He's full speed. He's full-go right now.
